title: DC254 evidence record
description: Common evidence register record for all Intelligence Monitor topics (Task 142). One record = one source item. Original source claims are kept verbatim in claims_extracted / evidence_excerpt; AI-generated fields (topic, role_category) are additions, never replacements.

record_type.description: search-result, job-ad, course, page, report, cable, tender, announcement, etc.

organisation.description: Company/agency/institution if evidenced; domain-prefixed form when only the domain is evidenced; UNKNOWN otherwise

country.description: Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, ... or UNKNOWN. Never inferred beyond what the source states.

published_at.description: Source publication date if available, else UNKNOWN

collected_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC - when DC254 collected it

event_date.description: Date of the actual event if known, else UNKNOWN

claims_extracted.description: Specific claims found in the source, verbatim or tightly paraphrased with wording preserved

last_checked_at.description: Most recent source check (collection counts as first check)

topic_fields.description: Topic-specific additions. facilities: operator/facilityLocation/capacityValue/capacityType/operationalStatus/projectStage. connectivity: cableName/landingPoint/rfsStatus/capacityValue/capacityUnit/operator. workforce: roleCategory/skillsRequired/qualificationsRequired/experienceRequired/employmentType/trainingMode/trainingProvider/programme. policy: issuingInstitution/policyType/relevantProvision/effectiveDate.
